events.title: JOINT HEARING OF THE EAST WENATCHEE PLANNING COMMISSION AND DOUGLAS COUNTY PLANNING COMMISSION – CONTINUED FROM OCTOBER 28TH
events.location:
City of East Wenatchee and Douglas County Joint Planning Commission meeting on November 18, 2026, is a continuation of the October 28, 2026, public hearing on Greater East Wenatchee Comprehensive Plan (including East Wenatchee Urban Growth Area), with corresponding amendments to zoning maps and development regulations.


AGENDA

Wednesday, November 18, 2026 - 6:00 PM

East Wenatchee City Hall, Council Chambers

271 9th Street NE, East Wenatchee, WA

The hearing will be conducted in person with an Zoom option. To join using Zoom, please use this

URL: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81035562054 Or phone number 1-253-215-8782. Meeting ID:

810 3556 2054.

Public Testimony will be limited to three minutes. If there are many speakers, a representative

may be appointed to speak on behalf of the group.

I. CALL TO ORDER

II. ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURES

A. None

III. CITIZEN COMMENT: The Citizen Comment period is to provide the opportunity for members of

the public to address the planning commission on a topic not on the agenda. The Chair will ask if

there are any citizens wishing to address the Commission. When recognized please step up to

the microphone, give your name and mailing address, and state the matter of interest. Citizen

comments will be limited to three minutes.

IV. OLD BUSINESS

A. None

V. NEW BUSINESS

A. Continued Public Hearing

Hearing procedures

A joint city/county public hearing continued from October 28th to consider amendments

to the Greater East Wenatchee Area Comprehensive Plan, EWMC Title 17 Zoning,

DCC Title 18A East Wenatchee UGA Zoning, and EWMC Title 19.11 Definitions.

Comprehensive plan amendments include text amendments, map amendments and

an expansion of the East Wenatchee Urban Growth Boundary. Development

regulation amendments include housing related changes and adoption of zoning maps

that correspond to the land use designation map in the comprehensive plan.

VI. OTHER BUSINESS

A. None

VII. ADJOURNMENT

- 271 NE 9th Street East Wenatchee WA 98802

events.title: Cowlitz County Noxious Weed Control Board Meetings
events.location:
The Cowlitz County Noxious Weed Control Board will meet on the 2nd Wednesday of each month in 2026, except there will be no meeting in March, July, and November. 

The meetings will be held at 6:00 PM in the first-floor conference room at the WSU Extension Office, 304 Cowlitz Way, Kelso, WA  98626. 

This calendar event is recurring; you may receive cancellations for the three meetings that won't occur, in addition to the initial calendar series. 

  • January 14 (6:oo PM Board Member Hearing, 6:20 PM Weed List Hearing)
  • February 11 
  • March – NO MEETING
  • April 8 
  • May 13
  • June 10
  • July – NO MEETING
  • August 12
  • September 9
  • October 14
  • November  – NO MEETING
  • December 9


- 304 Cowlitz Way KELSO WA 98626
